# Improve Writing

> Return the same text, clearer, with the author's voice intact and the meaning unchanged.

## Done means
- Meaning is preserved exactly. Any change that alters a claim is flagged rather than applied.
- Sentence length varies. Uniform rhythm is the signature of machine editing.
- Every cut word was doing no work. The edit is shorter and says the same thing.
- Hedges, filler openers, and throat-clearing are gone unless the hedge carries real uncertainty.
- The author's characteristic constructions survive. This is editing, not rewriting in another voice.

## Output contract
```
## Edited text
<the full text, edited, ready to use>

## Changes of substance
| location | original | edited | why |
<only changes that could alter meaning or tone — not every comma>

## Flagged
<claims that seemed wrong or unsupported, left as written>
```

## Gotchas
Do not add structure the author did not want. Bullet lists imposed on argument prose destroy the argument. Do not raise the register; plain words beat impressive ones.
